newsitem.title: CHINA: Shanghai copper futures end down on LME losses.
newsitem.headline: Shanghai copper futures end down on LME losses.

text.p: Shanghai copper futures ended down on Tuesday, shaking off overnight gains on the London Metal Exchange (LME) and local gains on Monday, traders said.

Tuesday's falls reversed the sharp gains of Monday when copper futures closed up on market talk that China had suspended copper imports and that domestic copper traders had been ordered not to sell their red metal to support prices, they said.
Beijing's metals trading arm China National Nonferrous Metal Import Export Corp (CNIEC) said imports had not been suspended.
A CNIEC official said it recommended last week that traders not sell, but now it was recommending they sell on firmer prices.
